steps.prompt_exact: My roommates and I keep getting weird utility bills with different due dates and partial Venmo payments; can you make a simple browser tool that turns those bills into a clear who-owes-what board?
steps.response_exact:
This roommate bill splitter handles irregular billing periods, distinct due dates, and existing partial payments. It automatically tracks total costs, subtracts any partial Venmo payments already made, and breaks down exactly who owes what to keep balances square.

Interactive visual ready
